components.tract_note: Cortex innovation district in St. Louis city plus the 39 North AgTech district in St. Louis County (Creve Coeur area); sub-county, no federal geography.

market.reason: Two districts (the Cortex district in St. Louis city and the 39 North district in St. Louis County) rather than the metro; 'SAINT LOUIS' is the county string but is ambiguous with the city, and 'SAINT LOUIS CITY' is the city string.

note: Headline values only. SBA FOIA series give the FY2016-2025 window, and a class with no loans in it is left out (zero); CBP leaves out classes with no establishments (zero), and the bundles leave out CBP employment and establishments per 10,000 residents. The series files under data/markets/series/ hold every window, year and series.
